title: Gukesh v Sindarov, Game 3
why: Game 3 of the world championship match in Geneva ended in a 60-move draw, leaving it tied 1.5-1.5; streamed free on YouTube.

title: Players Championship Finals, Round One (Stephen Bunting v Max Hopp)
why: Bunting meets Max Hopp in round one at Minehead, the last match on Stage Two in the evening session that starts at 2:00 PM New York time; Luke Littler did not qualify.

title: Gukesh v Sindarov, Game 4
why: Game 4 of the world championship match in Geneva follows Friday's rest day, with the match level at 1.5-1.5; play starts at 15:00 Geneva time and streams free on YouTube.

title: UK Championship, first day (York)
why: The UK Championship opens at the York Barbican with sessions at 1 PM and 7 PM UK time (8 AM and 2 PM New York); US broadcaster not confirmed.
